The town is well served by road communications  including the A238 and A219 both providing access to the A3 to the west and north-west  respectively, whilst the A24 provides a direct link to the M25 (Junction 9) to the  south. Nearby occupiers include YMCA Wimbledon,  Majestic Wine, Henry J Beans, a number of local shops and restaurants and The Antoinette  Hotel. Description The  property comprises a prominent three storey terraced building arranged as a ground  floor restaurant with a three bedroom flat arranged over the first and second floors. The A485 provides  access via the A48 to the M4 Motorway (Junction 49) to the south and to Aberystwyth  to the north via the A487. The university adds a significant number of people to  the town's population each year. The picturesque Brecon Beacons National Park is  located just to the south-east of the town. Rail services from Carmarthen Mainline  Station to London (Paddington) via Swansea have a journey time of about 4 hours. The  property occupies a prominent position on Harford Square, adjacent to College Street,  within the heart of the town centre. Nearby occupiers include Lloyds TSB Bank, Barclays  Bank and Lloyds Pharmacy. Description The  property comprises a prominent two storey building arranged as a ground floor banking  hall and first floor offices/ancillary. There is a yard to the side and rear of  the building. Tenure Freehold. VAT Value  Added Tax is not applicable to this lot. Contact Oliver  Childs +44 (0) 20 7877 4517. It is located about 90 miles north of London and  35 miles north-west of Cambridge. The A1(M) Motorway (Junction 17) is situated 4  miles to the west whilst nearby rail services from Peterborough to London (Kings  Cross) provided by National Express have an approximate journey time of 53 minutes.  Stansted, Luton and East Midlands airports are all within an hour's drive. The  property is located on the north side of Empson Road, which runs between Newark  Road and Edgerley Drain Road, just to the east of Frank Perkins Parkway (A1139)  and within the largest and most established employment area of the city. Nearby  occupiers in the area include Perkins Engines, British Car Auctions, Ideal Home  Shopping plc, Topps Tiles, Travis Perkins, Halfords and Plumb Center. There are  also a number of car dealerships just over one mile to the south of the property  including Jaguar, VW and Volvo. Description The  property comprises a terrace of four industrial/warehouse buildings of steel portal  frame construction with elevations clad in a combination of brick and block work  and insulated profiled metal sheet cladding to an internal eaves height of 5.50  metres (18 ft). Each unit benefits from a loading door to the front elevation and  is arranged as a ground floor production area with concrete first floor mezzanine,  which in some cases has been fitted out as offices. There is adequate car parking  on a site of approximately 0.57 hectares (1.41 acres). Tenure Freehold. VAT Value  Added Tax is applicable to this lot. Contact Oliver  Childs +44 (0) 20 7877 4517. The A414 links  the town with Hatfield, Welwyn Garden City and the M1 Motorway (Junction 4). Regular  rail services from Hertford East and Hertford West mainline stations to London (Moorgate,  Kings Cross and Liverpool Street) have a fastest journey time of about 42 minutes. The  property occupies a prominent position in the pedestrianised town centre Conservation  Area, on the north side of Maidenhead Street, almost opposite Honey Lane and just  to the west of Salisbury Square. The property is adjacent to the Co-Operative Pharmacy  whilst other nearby occupiers include The Edinburgh Woollen Mill, Stead & Simpson,  Oxfam and Clinton Cards. Description The  property comprises a prominent two storey terraced building arranged as a ground  floor shop with first floor storage accommodation. Planning Permission  was granted on appeal (Ref: 3/08/0644/FP dated 01/04/2008) on 11/06/2009 for alterations  to existing shop and development of four studio flats above. The proposed flats  vary in size from 25.45 sq m (274 sq ft) to 40.00 sq m (431 sq ft). These measurements  have been provided by the Seller's Architect. For further enquiries please contact  East Herts District Council on Tel: (01279) 655261 or visit their website at www.eastherts.gov.uk Tenure Freehold. The village is approximately 5 miles  to the south-west of Hythe and approximately 3 miles to the north-east of New Romney.  The popular coastal towns of Rye and Camber are 8 miles to the west and the area  benefits from a large influx of holidaymakers in the summer months. The  A259 coastal road passes through the village and the M20 Motorway (Junction 11)  is approximately 8 miles to the north. The Romney, Hythe and Dymchurch narrow gauge  railway also passes through the village. The  property is situated on the south-eastern side of the High Street opposite the junction  with Mill Road. The property is within an established retail trading area characterised  by local independent traders. Adjacent occupiers include a Hospice Bookshop and  Tandoori Takeaway. Description The  property comprises a single storey mid terrace lock-up shop fronting Dymchurch High  Street. No. 6 High Street, to the south, extends around the rear of the property.  The subject property accordingly has party walls to both sides and the rear. Tenure Freehold.  The property is being offered for sale by the mortgagee NOT in possession. Vacant  possession cannot be guaranteed on completion and the property will be sold subject  to any leases, licences or occupancies that may exist. Buyers are advised to satisfy  themselves by making their own enquiries. VAT Value  Added Tax is not applicable to this lot. Contact Sandy Hamilton +44 (0) 20 7877 4518.
